notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least seven.
description:
Cast Master of Waves by paying {3}{U}.
Master of Waves enters the battlefield, creating at least eight 1/0 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing seven Elemental tokens, adding {6}{U}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing an Elemental token, returning Master of Waves from the battlefield to your hand.
Any remaining 1/0 Elemental creature tokens you control die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat.
